has.query: SELECT `profile`.`id`, `profile`.`image`, `profile`.`name`, `profile`.`type`, `profile`.`roles`, `profile`.`tags`, `profile`.`references`, `profile`.`active`, `profile`.`created`, `profile`.`updated` FROM `profile` WHERE "profile"."active" = ?
